study: Selected four-pair source-control design and passive controls
scope: Digital emission-mode/HOM-instrument emulation; no optical acquisition, multi-block classifier, physical reset or semiconductor validation.

circuits.name: selected_four_coherent

metadata.optical_scope: Digitally encoded exponential photon modes and SWAP symmetry. Optical collection and confusion excluded.

circuits.reference_bit_convention: The first listed marginal qubit is least significant. Raw Qiskit strings put logicalqubit0 at right. Flag histories below are chronological.
circuits.memory_measurement_scope: Z only; conditional matrix is an ideal reference, not experimentally complete tomography.
